name: search-hub.provider-quality-read
purpose: Join insights, providers list, federation status, and the newest eval run per suite into one bounded per-provider table with the out-of-band lists the improve skill files against provider owners.

insights_window.description: insights window: a bare integer is days; a duration such as 15m or 2h is accepted.

provider_group.description: Restrict the table to one provider group (scenario).

max_rows.description: Largest provider table returned (1..100); parsed in validate, a non-integer is invalid_input. The envelope must fit the 4 KB stdout bound, so filter with provider_group instead of raising it.

assumptions: search-hub is running and its insights, providers, federation, and evals bindings are reachable from the kernel
degradation band 0.20 is the degraded_rate_max every provider descriptor declares in search.json
the newest run per suite may carry a strategy-compare tag; the caller reads the tag before treating pass_rate as the incumbent's
a suite runs read that fails with a transport class other than scenario_unreachable is recorded as an error and the status is partial; search-hub going unreachable mid-collect is unavailable
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
one evals runs call per registered suite, limit 1, run concurrently; no retry
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
the envelope stays within the 4 KB stdout bound: providers are capped by max_rows, evidence at six run ids, and each derived list at five rows with a count beside it

signals.providers: at most max_rows of {provider_id, lifecycle, reachable, circuit, routed, hits, degradation, reasons, p95_ms, retire, eval[{suite, pass, prec, at}]}; suite ids are cut to their first 40 characters
signals.provider_count: providers in the registry after the group filter
signals.unreachable: providers federation status reports unreachable now, or whose insights degradation reasons in the window include unreachable: {provider_id, reachability, now, unreachable_in_window}
signals.under_utilized: providers insights lists as retirement candidates (zero hits over routed calls)
signals.suites_without_runs: registered suites with no stored run
signals.suites_below_full_pass: at most 8 suites whose newest run has pass_rate below 1.0
signals.fleet: fleet totals from insights: totalQueries, zeroResultQueries, zeroResultRate, degradedQueries, latencyP95Ms
signals.suites_below_full_pass_count: How many registered suites are below a full pass; the list carries at most five.
